REQ_001: A clinic with a main and a branch and 30 staff, so first the clinic needs good internet, maybe 200mbp at the main and 100mbp at the branch, and a computer for every doctor and receptionist. The records should be on a system both sites can open so the patient doesn't have to repeat everything if they go to the other one. If the internet goes down they could use mobile data from a phone until it comes back. When they hire more people they can just buy more computers.
REQ_002: A university building that has 6 labs with 35 PCs each and 12 classrooms, so 210 PCs in the labs, each lab should have a teacher PC and a printer too. The classrooms need a projector and a smart board each and the teacher connects the laptop to it. For the online exams the students should close all other programs and the teacher watches them so nobody cheats. The IT staff is small so they should hire 1 or 2 more people to help.
LOG_001: A company with 3 departments HR, Finance and Engineering, so each one should have their own room and their own shared folder on the server. Engineering works with big files so they need faster computers and a bigger hard drive on the server. Finance has sensitive data so only Finance people get the password to the Finance folder, and the manager approves who gets added. HR keeps the employees files and does the hiring so they mostly need email and the HR system.
PROT_001: A campus with multiple buildings, so I'd go with RIP because it's simple to set up and the IT staff won't need much training, you just enable it on the routers and they share their routes with each other automatically. If the campus grows they can add more routers and turn RIP on there too.
SEC_001: A company with remote work and a website, so everyone should have antivirus on their laptop and keep it updated. The remote workers should not use public WiFi in cafes. Passwords should be changed every month and written somewhere safe. The website should be backed up every week in case it gets hacked so they can restore it.
